about.en: PLTRon is the Ondo tokenized stock for Palantir Technologies Inc. (PLTR), issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited on the Ondo Global Markets platform and offered to eligible non-US investors. It is fully backed by PLTR shares and is a total-return tracker: dividends are reinvested net of withholding tax, so one token can come to represent more than one share and its price can drift above the underlying's. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership or shareholder rights. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0x0c666485b02F7A87d21AdD7AEb9F5e64975AA490, with deployments on BNB Chain, Solana and HyperEVM.
